units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 46b:15">Snh. 46ᵇ</cite> <he>קבורה משום ב׳</he> is burial required in order to prevent disgrace (to the dead and his relatives)? <cite ref="Sanhedrin 46b:16">Ib.</cite> <he>א״א משום ב׳ הוא לא כל וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. … <he>ני דחיי … כל</he>) if you say, burial is required in order to prevent disgrace, he has no such power (as to prohibit it by his last will).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 45a:9">Ib. 45ᵃ</cite> [read:] <he>בזיוניה דאינש עדיף וכ׳</he> (the prevention of) disgrace stands to man higher than bodily ease (absence of pain), i.e. one would rather suffer protracted agony than exposure; (Var. lect. v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 8); <cite ref="Sotah 8b:5">Sot. 8ᵇ</cite>
